opening.argument: The description identifies the incident as a client’s “Fake Virus Popup” and expressly says the activity occurred “while investigating found that.” The footage follows that investigative framing: it shows the alarming authentication dialog with username, password, and toll-free assistance fields, but no completed credential submission. It then examines Firefox’s Add-ons Manager, where Yahoo! Toolbar is listed, and a Yahoo! Toolbar information page with version and policy links. These are documented observations about a client-related popup and associated browser software, not a presentation of the credential or phone request as the creator’s own solicitation.

citations.quote: Yesterday one of our client has a issue with Fake Virus Popup
